usedFor: Contacts+ holds your contacts and Conversion Chats sends a template message, so a transcribed business card can start a chat.

bestTemplate.name: “When a business card is transcribed” in Contacts+, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new business card is a fresh contact, and the action greets them with a template message.

watchOut: Reaching a contact outside your team means “Send Template Message” waits in Needs you for your approval.
